intro: This is a mantra from the **Samaveda** (Samaveda 1.1 (same verse as Rigveda 6.16.10)). Below are the Sanskrit text and a **plain English meaning**.
takeaways: The four Vedas are Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda and Atharvaveda.
Vedic mantras are learned by listening and repeating.

p: **अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥**
Come, Agni, praised, to partake of the offering. Sit down as priest on the sacred grass.
The Samaveda is one of the four Vedas, the oldest scriptures of Sanatana Dharma, handed down by voice for thousands of years.

faq.a: Come, Agni, praised, to partake of the offering. Sit down as priest on the sacred grass.
There are **four**: Rig, Yajur, Sama and Atharva.

note: The Sanskrit is the traditional text. The English is our own plain rendering.
